clauses.clause_label: 一、个人与开源用途 —— 免费
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the software and its derivative works. The free grant covers the listed activities only in the specified personal or qualifying open-source contexts; it is not an unrestricted grant for other uses. Generated text-and-image works are stated to be outside this license's restrictions, but are distinct from the licensed software and its derivatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: At least one listed use context must apply. For the open-source-project alternative, the project must use an OSI-approved license and publish complete source. In all cases, retain the license and copyright notice in source code or documentation.

clauses.clause_label: 二、闭源 / 商业用途 —— 需购买商业授权
clauses.scope_note: The restriction concerns using the software, its derivatives, or a substantial portion in closed-source software or services, SaaS, products whose source is not public, for-profit products or services, or equivalent closed commercial scenarios. The text specifically clarifies that embedding the software in a closed/commercial product for redistribution needs authorization. It does not restrict commercial use of generated text-and-image works themselves. This clause requires prior written commercial authorization; the text does not provide its terms or establish that authorization is granted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the specified closed-source, commercial, or equivalent use occurs without a commercial license obtained in advance in writing.

coverage_notes: The Chinese clauses control over the English summary. The summary is not separately extracted.
Generated text-and-image works/cards are expressly said to be unrestricted by this license, including commercial use; they are not treated as the licensed software or its derivatives here.
The text says commercial authorization is paid and must be obtained in advance in writing, but supplies no price or full authorization terms.
Warranty and liability disclaimers were omitted as unrelated to the requested activities.
